Stir in cooled sugar syrup mixture.
Cap and let age for 2 days.
Remove apricot halves. (Save apricot halves, can be used for cooking).
Add food coloring and glycerine.
Stir, recap and continue aging for 1 to 2 months.
Re-bottle as desired.
Liqueur is ready to serve but will continue to improve with additional aging.

steps: Prepare in a blender or shaker, serve in a highball glass on the rocks.
Garnish with 1 slice of pineapple and one cherry.

cocktails.name: Boston Sidecar
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktails.name: Boston Sour
steps: Shake juice of lemon, powdered sugar, blended whiskey, and egg white with cracked ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass.
Add the slice of lemon, top with the cherry, and serve.

cocktails.name: Boulevardier
steps: Stir with ice, strain, garnish and serve.

cocktails.name: Bounty Hunter
steps: Add the spirits into a shaker as well as the pineapple juice, strain into a Margarita glass.
Top with Prosecco and garnish with Blueberries.

cocktails.name: Bourbon Sling
steps: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the sugar, water, lemon juice, and bourbon.
Shake well.
Strain well.
Strain into a highball glass.
Garnish with the lemon twist.

cocktails.name: Bourbon Sour
steps: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the bourbon, lemon juice, and sugar.
Shake well.
Strain into a whiskey sour glass, garnish with the orange slice and cherry.

cocktails.name: Boxcar
steps: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients.
Shake well.
Strain into a sour glass.

cocktails.name: Brain Fart
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Slowly and gently.
Works best if ice is added to punch bowl and soda's are very cold.

cocktails.name: Brainteaser
steps: layered erin first, then sambuca and then avocart(should sit in middle of other two.
To drink: use a straw to suck up avocart then shot the rest and then suck fumes up through straw.

cocktails.name: Bramble
steps: Fill glass with crushed ice.
Build gin, lemon juice and simple syrup over.
Stir, and then pour blackberry liqueur over in a circular fashion to create marbling effect.
Garnish with two blackberries and lemon slice.

cocktails.name: Brandon and Will's Coke Float
steps: Scoop two large scoops of vanilla ice-cream into frosted beer mug.
Next, add 2 ounces Maker's Mark.
Then, pour in coke.
Gently stir and enjoy.

cocktails.name: Brandy Alexander
steps: Shake all ingredients (except nutmeg) with ice and strain contents into a cocktail glass.
Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.

cocktails.name: Brandy Cobbler
cocktails.garnish: cherry and the orange and lemon slices
steps: In an old-fashioned glass, dissolve the sugar in the club soda.
Add crushed ice until the glass is almost full.
Add the brandy.
Stir well.
Garnish with the cherry and the orange and lemon slices.

cocktails.name: Brandy Flip
steps: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the brandy, egg, sugar, and cream.
Shake well.
Strain into a sour glass and garnish with the nutmeg.

cocktails.name: Brandy Sour
steps: Shake brandy, juice of lemon, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass.
Decorate with the lemon slice, top with the cherry, and serve.

cocktails.name: Brave Bull Shooter
steps: Pour Tabasco into bottom of shot glass and fill with tequila.

cocktails.name: Brigadier
steps: Mix ingredients in a warmed mug and stir.

cocktails.name: Broadside
steps: Half fill the glass with ice cubes.
Crush the wormwood and add to ice.
Pour rum, scotch and butters, then serve!

cocktails.name: Brooklyn
steps: Combine ingredients with ice and stir until well-chilled.
Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Bruce's Puce
steps: In a regular-sized shot glass, layer, with a spoon or cherry, the grenadine , the Kahlua , then the Bailey's Irish cream in equal portions.
It goes down really smooth ,and you don't even need a chaser.
It tastes just like chocolate milk.(Really!).

cocktails.name: Bruised Heart
steps: Pour all ingredients in a mixing tin over ice, stir, and strain into shot glass.

cocktails.name: Bubble Gum
steps: Layer in order into a shot glass.

cocktails.name: Buccaneer
steps: Pour the corona into an 18oz beer glass pour the bacardi limon into the beer stir very gently.

cocktails.name: Bumble Bee
steps: This is a layered shot.
First pour the Bailey's into the shot glass.
Then take an upside down spoon and touch it to the inside wall of the glass.
Carefully add the Kahlua.
Repeat this process for the Sambuca.
If done properly, the alcohol will stay separated and resemble a bumble bee.
Enjoy!!!

cocktails.name: Butter Baby
steps: Blend together in a blender.
Serve in a chilled Beer mug with Fresh Blueberries and caramel for topping.

cocktails.name: Butterfly Effect
steps: Grab your boston tin, fill it with cubes ice and then simply chuck in all your ingredients apart from your lemonade.
Now it’s time to shake what your mama gave you until all your ingredients are blended to perfection.
Add some cubes of ice to your hurricane glass, give them a swill to cool the whole thing down and then strain your raspberry vodka cocktail of wonder into the glass.
Top with lemonade and chuck a sprig of mint on top for garnish.
You can either get drinking at this point or go and try and grab a few butterflies to finish, the choice really is yours.

cocktails.name: Cafe Savoy
steps: Fill mug almost to top with coffee.Add milk, triple sec and brandy.
Stir.

cocktails.name: Caipirinha
steps: Place lime and sugar into old fashioned glass and muddle (mash the two ingredients together using a muddler or a wooden spoon).
Fill the glass with ice and add the Cachaça.

cocktails.name: Caipirissima
steps: Same as Caipirinha but instead of cachaca you add WHITE RUM.
It's great!!!!!!!!

cocktails.name: California Lemonade
steps: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a collins glass over shaved ice.
Fill with carbonated water and stir.
Decorate with slices of orange and lemon.
Add the cherry and serve with a straw.

cocktails.name: California Root Beer
steps: Put Kahlua and Galliano in highball glass fill with soda.

cocktails.name: Campari Beer
steps: Use a 15 oz glass.
Add Campari first.
Fill with beer.

cocktails.name: Captain Kidd's Punch
steps: Mix all ingredients together in a shaker and strain into a collins glass.
Use Caribbean dark Rum for a sweeter taste.

cocktails.name: Caribbean Boilermaker
steps: Pour the Corona into an 18oz beer glass pour the rum into the beer.

cocktails.name: Caribbean Orange Liqueur
steps: Pare very thinly the bright-colored rind from the oranges (no white).
Blot the peel on paper towels to remove any excess oil.
Put peel in a 4 cup screw-top jar.
Add 2 cups vodka.
Close jar.
Store in a cool, dark place for 2 days or until the vodka has absorbed the flavor.
Remove peel and add remaining vodka.
Close jar and add remaining cup of vodka.
Close the jar and store in a cool dark place at least 1 month to age.

cocktails.name: Casa Blanca
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktails.name: Casino
cocktails.garnish: lemon twist and a maraschino cherry
steps: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes.
Shake well.
Strain into chilled cocktail glass.
Garnish with a lemon twist and a maraschino cherry.
Serve without a straw.

cocktails.name: Casino Royale
steps: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients.
Shake well.
Strain into a sour glass.

cocktails.name: Castillian Hot Chocolate
steps: Shift the cocoa and sugar together into a medium-sized saucepan.
Dissolve the cornstarch in the water, and stir into the cocoa and sugar until it is a smooth paste.
Begin heating the mixture, stirring it with a whisk, and gradually pour in the milk.
Continue stirring with the whisk as you bring the liquid to a simmer.
Allow the chocolate to simmer for about 10 minutes, stirring often, until it is thick, glossy and completely smooth.
Serve steaming hot in coffee mug.
Serves six.

cocktails.name: Champagne Cocktail
steps: Add dash of Angostura bitter onto sugar cube and drop it into champagne flute.
Add cognac followed by gently pouring chilled champagne.
Garnish with orange slice and maraschino cherry.

cocktails.name: Cherry Electric Lemonade
steps: Now stir vigorously and then pour over a large cup of ice.
Now drink it with a straw and stir occasionally.

cocktails.name: Cherry Rum
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktails.name: Chicago Fizz
steps: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes.

cocktails.name: Chocolate Beverage
steps: Boil milk in the top of a deep double boiler five minutes.
Remove from fire and add chocolate, mixed with the cinnamon, a little at a time, beating with molinillo or egg beater after each addition.
When the chocolate is thoroughly blended, heat to the boiling point.
Place over bottom of double boiler and add eggs, whipping constantly, until they are thoroughly blended and the mixture is frothing.
Serve in coffee mug.
Serves eight.

cocktails.name: Chocolate Black Russian
steps: Combine all ingredients in an electric blender and blend at a low speed for a short length of time.
Pour into a chilled champagne flute and serve.

cocktails.name: Chocolate Drink
steps: Melt the bar in a small amount of boiling water.
Add milk.
Cook over low heat, whipping gently (with a whisk, i would assume) until heated well.
Don't let it boil!
Serve in coffee mug.

cocktails.name: Chocolate Milk
steps: Put the milk in the bottom, pour the Liquer on top and add the dash of amaretto.
Do not mix.
SLAM IT!

cocktails.name: Chocolate Monkey
steps: blend liqeuors with ice-cream, milk and syrup. pour into parfait glass, top with whipped cream and garnish with banana and cherry.

cocktails.name: Citrus Coke
steps: Pour half of coke in a glass.
Then add Bacardi and top it off with the remaining coke.
Stir and drink up!

cocktails.name: City Slicker
steps: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients.
Shake well.
Strain into a cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Classic Old-Fashioned
steps: In an old-fashioned glass, muddle the bitters and water into the sugar cube, using the back of a teaspoon.
Almost fill the glass with ice cubes and add the bourbon.
Garnish with the orange slice and the cherry.
Serve with a swizzle stick.

cocktails.name: Clove Cocktail
steps: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktails.name: Clover Club
steps: Dry shake ingredients to emulsify, add ice, shake and served straight up.

cocktails.name: Cocktail Horse’s Neck
steps: Wash and brush an organic, untreated lemon, then cut a spiral of lemon peel, using a citrus peel.
If it is too large, cut it with a sharp knife.
Put some ice in a tall tumbler glass, place the lemon peel inside and pour the cognac, add the ginger beer and let 2-3 drops of Angostura fall into it.
Easy to do, but once you try it you'll love it.

cocktails.name: Coffee Liqueur
steps: Combine coffee, sugar and water.
Simmer 1 hour and let cool.
Add vanilla and vodka.
Age in sealed jar 2 to 3 weeks.

cocktails.name: Coffee-Vodka
steps: Boil water and sugar until dissolved.
Turn off heat.
Slowly add dry instant coffee and continue stirring.
Add a chopped vanilla bean to the vodka, then combine the cooled sugar syrup and coffee solution with the vodka.
Cover tightly and shake vigorously each day for 3 weeks.
Strain and filter.
Its also best to let the sugar mixture cool completely so the vodka won't evaporate when its added.
If you like a smoother feel to the liqueur you can add about 1 teaspoon of glycerine to the finished product.

cocktails.name: Coke and Drops
steps: Take a glass, pour the Coke in the glass, then you take 7 drops of lemon juice.
Granish with a lemon slice on the rim of the glass.

cocktails.name: Corn n Oil
steps: Cut the half lime in half again.
Add the lime, falernum, and bitters to a rocks glass.
Muddle.
Add the rum. (Aged Barbados rum such as Plantation 5 Year is recommended).
Add ice and stir.
Float the blackstrap rum on top.
Serve with a straw.

cocktails.name: Corpse Reviver
steps: Shake, strain, straight up, cocktail glass rinsed with absinthe.

cocktails.name: Cosmopolitan
cocktails.lore: The Cosmopolitan was popularized by Sex and the City in the late 1990s, but its true origin is debated. Bartender Cheryl Cook claims to have invented it in Miami in 1985, while Toby Cecchini takes credit for the version served at the Odeon in New York in 1988. Either way, it became the defining cocktail of the 1990s — and is due for a serious re-evaluation.
cocktails.proTip: Use just enough cranberry juice to turn the drink pink. Too much and you lose the citrus brightness. The cranberry is for color and a hint of tartness, not to dominate.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a cocktail shaker.
Fill with ice and shake vigorously for 12–15 seconds until well-chilled.
Strain into your prepared glass.
Garnish with flamed orange peel.

cocktails.name: Cosmopolitan Martini
steps: Pour all ingredients in mixing glass half filled with ice, shake and strain into chilled Martini glass.

cocktails.name: Cranberry Cordial

Add the sugar and rum.
Adjust the lid securely and place the jar in a cool, dark place.
Invert the jar and shake it every day for six weeks.

Cool.

Add rum.

cocktails.lore: Named after a beach near Santiago, Cuba, the Daiquiri was supposedly created by American mining engineer Jennings Cox in 1898 when he ran out of gin and improvised with local rum. Ernest Hemingway later immortalized it by drinking them by the dozen at Havana's El Floridita — frozen and with extra lime.
cocktails.proTip: The classic ratio is 2:¾:¾ but the best Daiquiri is one calibrated to your specific rum and limes. Taste and adjust before you shake.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a cocktail shaker.
Fill with ice and shake vigorously for 12–15 seconds until well-chilled.
Strain into your prepared glass.
Garnish with lime wheel on rim.

cocktails.name: Damned if you do
steps: Pour into shot glass.
Put in mouth.
Repeat as deemed necessary.

cocktails.name: Danbooka
steps: pour it in and mix it.

cocktails.name: Dark 'n' Stormy
cocktails.lore: The Dark 'n' Stormy is one of the few trademarked cocktails in existence — Gosling's Brothers of Bermuda owns the name and stipulates that Gosling's Black Seal rum must be used. The drink became the national drink of Bermuda, where local sailors drank it after long ocean crossings, the dark rum floating dramatically on pale ginger beer like storm clouds over the sea.
cocktails.proTip: Float the rum on top of the ginger beer rather than mixing it in — this creates the signature storm cloud effect and a more complex sip.
steps: Fill your glass with ice.
Add ingredients in order, finishing with any carbonated components.
Give a single gentle stir to incorporate.
Garnish with lime wedge, candied ginger.

cocktails.name: Dark and Stormy
steps: In a highball glass filled with ice add 6cl dark rum and top with ginger beer.
Garnish with lime wedge.

cocktails.name: Dark Caipirinha

Pour the cachaca into the glass.

cocktails.name: Derby

cocktails.name: Diesel

steps: This is a layered shot - the Bailey's must be on top.

cocktails.name: Downshift

Next comes the tequila.
After that, add the Minute Maid Fruit Punch, then float the 151.
Rocks optional.

cocktails.name: Dragonfly
steps: In a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes, combine the gin and ginger ale.
Stir well.
Garnish with the lime wedge.

cocktails.name: Drinking Chocolate
steps: Heat the cream and milk with the cinnamon and vanilla bean very slowly for 15-20 minutes. (If you don't have any beans add 1-2 tsp of vanilla after heating).
Remove the bean and cinnamon.
Add the chocolate.
Mix until fully melted.
Serve topped with some very dense fresh whipped cream.
Serves 1-2 depending upon how much of a glutton you are.

Serve in coffee mug.

cocktails.name: Dry Martini
steps: Straight: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes.
Stir well.
Strain in chilled martini cocktail glass.
Squeeze oil from lemon peel onto the drink, or garnish with olive.

cocktails.name: Dry Rob Roy
steps: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine the Scotch and vermouth.
Stir well.
Strain into a cocktail glass.
Garnish with the lemon twist.

cocktails.name: Dubonnet Cocktail
steps: Stir all ingredients (except lemon peel) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass.
Add the twist of lemon peel and serve.

cocktails.name: Duchamp's Punch
steps: Shake all ingredients.
Double strain in a chilled double old fashioned glass with abig ice cube.
Garnish with a couple of lavender sprigs.

cocktails.name: Egg Cream
steps: Mix syrup and milk in a fountain glass.
Add soda water, serve with a straw.

cocktails.name: Egg Nog - Healthy
steps: Whip egg substitute and sugar together, combine with the two kinds of milk, vanilla, and rum.
Mix well.
Chill over night.
Sprinkle with nutmeg.
Makes 6 servings.

cocktails.name: Egg Nog #4
steps: In a small mixer bowl beat egg yolks till blended.
Gradually add 1/4 cup sugar, beating at high speed till thick and lemon colored.
Stir in milk, stir in rum, bourbon, vanilla, and salt.
Chill thoroughly.
Whip cream.
Wash beaters well.
In a large mixer bowl beat egg whites till soft peaks form.
Gradually add remaining 1/4 cup sugar, beating to stiff peaks.
Fold yolk mixture and whipped cream into egg whites.
Serve immediately.
Sprinkle nutmeg over each serving.
Serve in a punch bowl or another big bowl.
NOTE: For a nonalcoholic eggnog, prepare Eggnog as above, except omit the bourbon and rum and increase the milk to 3 cups.

cocktails.name: Egg-Nog - Classic Cooked
steps: In large saucepan, beat together eggs, sugar and salt, if desired.
Stir in 2 cups of the milk.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is thick enough to coat a metal spoon and reaches 160 degrees F.
Remove from heat.
Stir in remaining 2 cups milk and vanilla.
Cover and regfigerate until thoroughly chilled, several hours or overnight.
Just before serving, pour into bowl or pitcher.
Garnish or add stir-ins, if desired.

Choose 1 or several of: Chocolate curls, cinnamon sticks, extracts of flavorings, flavored brandy or liqueur, fruit juice or nectar, ground nutmeg, maraschino cherries, orange slices, peppermint sticks or candy canes, plain brandy, run or whiskey, sherbet or ice-cream, whipping cream, whipped.
Serve immediately.

cocktails.name: Elderflower Caipirinha
steps: Take the glass and muddle the lime in it.
Fill the glass with crushed ice and add the Cachaca.
Stir well and top with some more crushed ice.
Garnish with lime and enjoy!

cocktails.name: Empellón Cocina's Fat-Washed Mezcal
steps: To ensure that your pork fat is just as delicious as theirs, here’s their adobo marinade and what to do with it (you’ll also need a rack of ribs):.

ancho chiles, 8 guajillo chiles and 4 chipotle chiles, plus 4 cloves roasted garlic, half a cup of cider vinegar, a quarter teaspoon of Mexican oregano, 1 teaspoon of ground black pepper, a whole clove, a quarter teaspoon of ground cinnamon and a half teaspoon of ground cumin.
Toast the dried chiles and soak in water for at least an hour until they are rehydrated.
Drain and discard the soaking liquid.
Combine the soaked chiles with the remaining ingredients and purée until smooth.
Cold smoke a rack of baby back pork ribs by taking a large hotel pan with woodchips on one side and charcoal on the other.
Place another, smaller, pan with pork ribs, above the charcoal/woodchip pan.
Ignite the charcoal, being careful to not ignite the woodchips.

Cover both pans with foil and allow to smoke for 10-15 minutes, until desired level of smoke is achieved, then coat with adobo marinade and wrap in tin foil prior to placing ribs in a 300 degree oven for 7 hours.
When the ribs have cooled, strain off the fat and use for the infusion.
If you’re having a hard time coming up to the same kind of volume of fat, make up the balance with pork lard from a butcher.
To get the same depth of flavor without the ribs, heat up the fat in a pot with a few spoons of the marinade.
Once you’ve got your tub of seasoned pork fat in cooled liquid form, pour equal amounts of Ilegal Joven mezcal and fat into a sealable container.
Seal the container and give it a really good shake, then put it in the freezer overnight.
When the whole thing is separated and congealed, pour it through a fine mesh chinoise.
If you don’t have a chinoise, try a fine mesh strainer, or if you don’t have one of those, try spooning off most of the fat.
There will be some beads of orange fat left in the strained mezcal: run that through a few layers of cheesecloth (or coffee filters in a pinch) to get rid of the last of it.
The mezcal is now ready for drinking, straight-up or in a cocktail.
Habanero tincture.
Slice habaneros and add 2 ounces Ilegal Joven mezcal.
Allow to sit overnight or until desired level of heat is achieved.
Cocktail.
Combine mezcal and chocolate liqueur in a mixing glass with ice and stir for 45 seconds.
Strain into chilled coupe.
Carefully "sink" the coffee liqueur down the inside of the coupe over a spoon.
Garnish with 5 drops habanero tincture.

cocktails.name: English Highball
steps: Pour brandy, gin, and sweet vermouth into a highball glass over ice cubes.
Fill with carbonated water.
Add the twist of lemon peel, stir, and serve. (Ginger ale may be substituted for carbonated water, if preferred.).

cocktails.name: English Rose Cocktail
steps: Rub rim of cocktail glass with lemon juice and dip rim of glass in powdered sugar.
Shake all ingredients (except cherry) with ice and strain into sugar-rimmed glass.
Top with the cherry and serve.

cocktails.name: Espresso Martini
cocktails.lore: The Espresso Martini was invented by Dick Bradsell at the Soho Brasserie in London in 1983. According to legend, a model (widely rumored to be Kate Moss) asked for something to 'wake me up and then f*** me up.' Bradsell grabbed the espresso machine that happened to be next to his bar station and created an impromptu coffee cocktail that conquered the world.
cocktails.proTip: Shake extremely hard with plenty of ice for at least 15 seconds. The three-foam-bubble crown only appears when the shake is vigorous enough to properly aerate.

Fill with ice and shake vigorously for 12–15 seconds until well-chilled.
Strain into your prepared glass.
Garnish with three coffee beans.

steps: Mix together in a cocktail glass.
Garnish with some choclate powder and coffee beans.

cocktails.name: Fahrenheit 5000
steps: Cover bottom of shot glass with Tabasco Sauce and then fill with half Firewater and half Absolut Peppar.

steps: In a lewis bag, crush up some ice like a baller/maniac (@glacioice).
Pour your precious ice into a collins glass.
In a cocktail shaker, muddle the figs and thyme together.
Add honey vodka, lemon juice, and a large ice cube (@glacioice).
Shake until well chilled, and strain into glass.
Add tonic water and finally 2 dashes of angostura bitters.

cocktails.name: Flaming Dr. Pepper
steps: Add Amaretto, Bacardi, and vodka.
Mix in the Dr.
Pepper and beer.

Pour the Baileys and Blue Curacao into two sepsrate shot glasses either side of the cocktail glass.

Set light the concotion in the cocktail glass and start to drink through the straw (this drink should be drunk in one) , as the bottom of the glass is reached put out the fire by pouring the Baileys and Blue Curacao into the cocktail glass and keep drinking till it's all gone!!

cocktails.name: Flander's Flake-Out
steps: Bang 'em both in.

cocktails.name: Flying Dutchman
steps: In an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes, combine the gin and triple sec.
Stir well.

cocktails.name: Flying Scotchman
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktails.name: Foxy Lady

steps: Mix together.
Blend at highest blender speed for about 1 minute.
Pour into a glass and drink with a straw.
Notes: This works best if everything is cold (if you make fresh coffee, mix it with the milk and let it sit in the fridge for 1/2 hour.
If it is not frothy, add more milk, or even just some more milk powder.
The froth gradually turns to liquid at the bottom of the glass, so you will find that you can sit and drink this for about 1/2 hour, with more iced coffee continually appearing at the bottom.
Very refreshing.

steps: make it an ample size shot!!

cocktails.name: French 75
