Shake vigorously and strain into a chilled champagne glass.
Top up with Champagne.
Stir gently.

cocktails.name: French Connection
steps: Pour all ingredients directly into old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes.
Stir gently.

cocktails.name: French Martini
steps: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes.
Shake well and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
Squeeze oil from lemon peel onto the drink.

cocktails.name: French Negroni
steps: Add ice to a shaker and pour in all ingredients.
Using a bar spoon, stir 40 to 45 revolutions or until thoroughly chilled.
Strain into a martini glass or over ice into a rocks glass.
Garnish with orange twist.

cocktails.name: Frisco Sour
steps: Shake all ingredients (except slices of lemon and lime) with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass.
Decorate with the slices of lemon and lime and serve.

cocktails.name: Frosé
steps: Step 1.
Pour rosé into a 13x9" pan and freeze until almost solid (it won't completely solidify due to the alcohol), at least 6 hours.
Step 2.
Meanwhile, bring sugar and ½ cup water to a boil in a medium saucepan; cook, stirring constantly, until sugar dissolves, about 3 minutes.
Add strawberries, remove from heat, and let sit 30 minutes to infuse syrup with strawberry flavor.
Strain through a fine-mesh sieve into a small bowl (do not press on solids); cover and chill until cold, about 30 minutes.
Step 3.
Scrape rosé into a blender.
Add lemon juice, 3½ ounces strawberry syrup, and 1 cup crushed ice and purée until smooth.
Transfer blender jar to freezer and freeze until frosé is thickened (aim for milkshake consistency), 25–35 minutes.
Step 4.
Blend again until frosé is slushy.
Divide among glasses.
Step 5.
Do Ahead: Rosé can be frozen 1 week ahead.

cocktails.name: Frozen Daiquiri
steps: Combine all ingredients (except for the cherry) in an electric blender and blend at a low speed for five seconds, then blend at a high speed until firm.
Pour contents into a champagne flute, top with the cherry, and serve.

cocktails.name: Frozen Mint Daiquiri
steps: Combine all ingredients with 1 cup of crushed ice in an electric blender.
Blend at a low speed for a short length of time.
Pour into an old-fashioned glass and serve.

cocktails.name: Frozen Pineapple Daiquiri
steps: Combine all ingredients with 1 cup of crushed ice in an electric blender.
Blend at a low speed for a short length of time.
Pour into a cocktail glass and serve.

cocktails.name: Fruit Cooler
steps: Toss strawberries with sugar, and let sit overnight in refrigerator.
Cut lemon, reserve two slices.
Juice the rest.
Mix together the lemon juice, strawberries, apple juice, and soda water.
Add slices of lemon (decor, really).
In glasses, put ice cubes, and a slice of apple.
Pour drink in, and serve.

cocktails.name: Fruit Flip-Flop
steps: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended.
Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up.

cocktails.name: Fruit Shake
steps: Blend til smooth.

cocktails.name: Funk and Soul
steps: Mix all ingredients together and strain into a Collins glass.
Use Jamaican rum where possible for a more authentic taste.

cocktails.name: Fuzzy Asshole
steps: fill coffe mug half full of coffee.
Fill the other half full of Peach Schnapps.
Stir and drink while hot.

cocktails.name: Gagliardo
steps: Shake well and serve in a cocktail glass.
This is a home cocktail of American/Internet Bar del Pozzo, Pavia, Italy.

cocktails.name: Garibaldi Negroni
steps: Mix together in a shaker and garnish with a simple orange slice.
Fill your vitamin C and cocktail fix at the same time!

cocktails.name: Gentleman's Club
steps: In an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients.
Stir well.

cocktails.name: GG
steps: Pour the Galliano liqueur over ice.
Fill the remainder of the glass with ginger ale and thats all there is to it.
You now have a your very own GG.

cocktails.name: Gideon's Green Dinosaur
steps: Add all ingredients in collins glass with ice and stir.

cocktails.name: Gimlet
cocktails.lore: The Gimlet appears in Raymond Chandler's novel 'The Long Goodbye' (1953), where Philip Marlowe declares: 'A real gimlet is half gin and half Rose's lime juice and nothing else.' The original used Rose's preserved lime cordial, but the modern craft version uses fresh lime and syrup — cleaner, brighter, and more vibrant.
cocktails.proTip: If you want to honor the original, try a split: half fresh lime, half Rose's lime cordial. You get the nostalgia and the brightness.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a cocktail shaker.
Fill with ice and shake vigorously for 12–15 seconds until well-chilled.
Strain into your prepared glass.
Garnish with lime wheel.

cocktails.name: Gin and Soda
steps: Pour the Gin and Soda water into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes.
Stir well.
Garnish with the lime wedge.

cocktails.name: Gin And Tonic
steps: Pour the gin and the tonic water into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes.
Stir well.
Garnish with the lime wedge.

cocktails.name: Gin Basil Smash
steps: Muddle Basil leaves (~ 10) with Suggar Syrup in a shaker.
Add Gin an Lemon Juice.
Filter and serve in a tumbler with ice.

cocktails.name: Gin Cooler
steps: Stir powdered sugar and 2 oz. carbonated water in a collins glass.
Fill glass with ice and add gin.
Fill with carbonated water and stir.
Add the lemon peel and the orange spiral so that the end of the orange spiral dangles over rim of glass.

cocktails.name: Gin Daisy
steps: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, lemon juice, sugar, and grenadine.
Shake well.
Pour into an old-fashioned glass and garnish with the cherry and the orange slice.

cocktails.name: Gin Fizz
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice cubes, except soda water.
Pour into glass.
Top with soda water.

cocktails.name: Gin Lemon
steps: For the preparation of the gin lemon you will not need the shaker.
Fill the tumbler with ice, pour the gin and lemonade over it.
Gently mix and decorate with a slice of lemon.
Those who prefer can also add a few mint leaves.
Your gin lemon is ready to be served.

cocktails.name: Gin Rickey
steps: Half-fill a tall glass with ice.
Mix the gin and Grenadine together and pour over the ice.
Add the lime or lemon juice and top off with soda water.
Decorate the glass with lime and/or lemon slices.

cocktails.name: Gin Sling
steps: Dissolve powdered sugar in mixture of water and juice of lemon.
Add gin.
Pour into an old-fashioned glass over ice cubes and stir.
Add the twist of orange peel and serve.

cocktails.name: Gin Smash
steps: Muddle sugar with carbonated water and mint sprigs in an old-fashioned glass.
Add gin and 1 ice cube.
Stir, add the orange slice and the cherry, and serve.

cocktails.name: Gin Sour
steps: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, lemon juice, and sugar.
Shake well.
Strain into a sour glass and garnish with the orange slice and the cherry.

cocktails.name: Gin Squirt
steps: Stir gin, grenadine, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a highball glass over ice cubes.
Fill with carbonated water and stir.
Decorate with the pineapple chunks and the strawberries and serve.

cocktails.name: Gin Swizzle
steps: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the lime juice, sugar, gin, and bitters.
Shake well.
Almost fill a colling glass with ice cubes.
Stir until the glass is frosted.
Strain the mixture in the shaker into the glass and add the club soda.

cocktails.name: Gin Toddy
steps: Mix powdered sugar and water in an old-fashioned glass.
Add gin and one ice cube.
Stir, add the twist of lemon peel, and serve.

cocktails.name: Gin Tonic
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice, pour the gin, top with tonic water and squeeze a lemon wedge and garnish with a lemon wedge.

cocktails.name: Girl From Ipanema
steps: Add the cachaca, lemon juice and syrup to your boston glass.
Add ice and shake until ice cold.
Pour into a chilled flute and top-up with Champagne.

cocktails.name: Gluehwein
steps: Boil sugar and spices in water, leave in the water for 30 minutes.
Strain the spiced water and mix with the wine.
Heat slowly until short of boiling temperature. (To remove alcohol, let it boil for a while.) You may add lemon or orange juice to taste.
Serve in irish coffee cup.

cocktails.name: Godchild
steps: Shake all ingredients well with cracked ice, strain into a champagne flute, and serve.

cocktails.name: Godfather
steps: Pour all ingredients directly into old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes.
Stir gently.

cocktails.name: Godmother
steps: Pour vodka and amaretto into an old-fashioned glass over ice and serve.

cocktails.name: Golden dream
steps: Shake with cracked ice.
Strain into glass and serve.

cocktails.name: Grand Blue
steps: Serve in an old fashioned glass.

cocktails.name: Grape lemon pineapple Smoothie
steps: Throw everything into a blender and liquify.

cocktails.name: Grass Skirt
steps: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, triple sec, pineapple juice, and grenadine.
Shake well.
Pour into an old-fashioned glass and garnish with the pineapple slice.

cocktails.name: Grasshopper
steps: Pour ingredients into a cocktail shaker with ice.
Shake briskly and then strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Green Goblin
steps: Cider First, Lager then Curacao.

cocktails.name: Greyhound
steps: Add the vodka to a Collins glass filled with ice.
Top with grapefruit juice and stir.

cocktails.name: Grim Reaper
steps: Mix Kahlua and 151 in glass.
Quickly add ice and pour grenadine over ice to give ice red tint.

cocktails.name: Grizzly Bear
steps: Served over ice.
Sounds nasty, but tastes great.

cocktails.name: H.D.
steps: Mix the whisky and Baileys Cream in a beer-glass (at least 50 cl).
Fill the rest of the glass with coffee.

cocktails.name: Halloween Punch
steps: Tip the cherry juice, orange peel, chilli, cinnamon sticks, cloves and ginger into a large saucepan.
Simmer for 5 mins, then turn off the heat.
Leave to cool, then chill for at least 4 hrs, or up to 2 days – the longer you leave it the more intense the flavours.
If serving to young children, take the chilli out after a few hours.
When you’re ready to serve, pour the juice into a jug.
Serve in glass bottles or glasses and pop a straw in each.
If you're adding vodka, do so at this stage.
Dangle a fangs sweet from each glass.

cocktails.name: Happy Skipper
steps: Pour Captain Morgan's Spiced Rum over ice, fill glass to top with Ginger Ale.
Garnish with lime.
Tastes like a cream soda.
Named for the Gilligan's Island reference ("The Captain" *in* "Ginger" is a Happy Skipper!).

cocktails.name: Harvey Wallbanger
steps: Stir the vodka and orange juice with ice in the glass, then float the Galliano on top.
Garnish and serve.

cocktails.name: Havana Cocktail
steps: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients.
Shake well.
Strain into a cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Hawaiian Cocktail
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktails.name: Hemingway Special
steps: Pour all ingredients into a shaker with ice.
Shake.

cocktails.name: Herbal flame
steps: Pour Hot Damn 100 in bottom of a jar or regular glass.
Fill the rest of the glass with sweet tea.
Stir with spoon, straw, or better yet a cinnamon stick and leave it in.

cocktails.name: Highland Fling Cocktail
steps: Stir all ingredients (except olive) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass.
Add the olive and serve.

cocktails.name: Holloween Punch
steps: Take a bunch of grape juice and a bunch of fizzy stuff (club soda, ginger ale, lemonlime, whatever).
Mix them in a punch bowl.
Take orange sherbet and lime sherbet.
Scoop out scoops and float them in the punch, let them melt a little so that a nasty film spreads all over the top of the punch but there are still "bubbles" in it in the form of sherbet scoops.
Looks horrible, tastes just fine.

cocktails.name: Homemade Kahlua
steps: Dissolve sugar in 2 cups of boiling water and add corn syrup.
Dissolve the instant coffee in the remaining water.
Pour syrup and coffee in a gallon jug.
Let it cool.
Add vodka and vanilla when cold.
For the best result, let the mixture "mature" for 4-5 weeks.

cocktails.name: Honey Bee
steps: Shake ingredients with crushed ice.

cocktails.name: Horse's Neck
steps: Pour brandy and ginger ale directly into highball glass with ice cubes.
Stir gently.
Garnish with lemon zest.
If desired, add dashes of Angostura Bitter.

cocktails.name: Hot Chocolate to Die for
steps: Melt the chocolate, butter and vanilla in a double boiler.
When just smooth stir in the cream.

cocktails.name: Hot Creamy Bush
steps: Combine all ingredients in glass.

cocktails.name: Hot Toddy
steps: STEP 1.
Whisk the whisky and honey together and split between 2 heatproof glasses.
Add half of the cinnamon stick to each, then top up with 200ml boiling water.
STEP 2.
Add a splash of lemon juice to each, then taste and add more to your preference.
Finish each with a slice of lemon, studded with a clove, and serve immediately.

cocktails.name: Hunter's Moon
steps: Put the Bombay Sapphire, Martini Bianco, sugar syrup & blackberries in a cocktail shaker with lots of ice and shake vigorously before pouring into a balloon glass, topping up with lemonade and garnishing with a wedge of orange.

cocktails.name: Ice Pick
steps: Put Vodka in glass fill with iced tea.
Stir in lemon to taste.

cocktails.name: Iced Coffee
steps: Mix together until coffee and sugar is dissolved.
Add milk.
Shake well.
Using a blender or milk shake maker produces a very foamy drink.
Serve in coffee mug.

cocktails.name: Iced Coffee Fillip
steps: Mix together in a coffee mug and chill before serving.

cocktails.name: Imperial Cocktail
steps: Shake with ice and strain into cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Imperial Fizz
steps: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes.
Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

cocktails.name: Ipamena
cocktails.garnish: rim of the glass with a slice of lime
steps: Cut half a lime into pieces, place in a shaker, add the sugar and crush.
Measure the passion fruit juice, add it to the shaker and fill up with ice cubes.
Close the shaker and shake vigorously.
Pour the liquid into a glass, top up with ginger ale, stir with a teaspoon and then garnish the rim of the glass with a slice of lime.

cocktails.name: Irish Coffee
steps: Heat the coffee, whiskey and sugar; do not boil.
Pour into glass and top with cream; serve hot.

cocktails.name: Irish Cream
steps: Mix scotch and milk.
Add half-and-half.
Add rest.

cocktails.name: Irish Curdling Cow
steps: Pour Irish Cream, Vodka, and Bourbon in a glass.
Add some ice and mix in the orange juice.

cocktails.name: Irish Russian
steps: Add the ingredients in the order listed in the recipe.
Care must be taken when adding the Guinness to prevent an excess of foam.
Do Not add ice.

cocktails.name: Irish Spring
cocktails.garnish: slice of orange, add the cherry on top, and serve
steps: Pour all ingredients (except orange slice and cherry) into a collins glass over ice cubes.
Garnish with the slice of orange, add the cherry on top, and serve.

cocktails.name: Jack Rose Cocktail
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktails.name: Jack's Vanilla Coke
steps: After pouring in your ingredients, and adding 3-5 ice cubes, according to taste.
Stir the drink with a stirrer to get the Vanilla off the bottom.

cocktails.name: Jackhammer
steps: Serve over ice- Warning,Deadly!

cocktails.name: Jam Donut
steps: Coat the rim of a shot glass with sugar using sugar syrup to stick.
Add the Chambord raspberry liqueur to the shot glass, and carefully layer the Baileys Irish Cream on top.
Serve.

cocktails.name: Jamaica Kiss
steps: Fill a tumbler with ice cubes.
Add a shot of Tia Maria and a shot of Jamaican light rum.
Fill the tumbler with milk.
Blend until smooth and serve immediately.

cocktails.name: Jamaican Coffee
steps: Stir the rum, coffee and water together.
Top with the whipped cream.
Sprinkle with a pinch of well ground coffee and drink with a straw.

cocktails.name: Japanese Fizz
steps: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes.
Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

cocktails.name: Jello shots
steps: Boil 3 cups of water then add jello.
Mix jello and water until jello is completely disolved.
Add the two cups of vodka and mix together.
Pour mixture into plastic shot glasses and chill until firm.
Then, eat away...

cocktails.name: Jelly Bean
steps: mix equal parts in pony glass-tastes just like a jelly bean!

cocktails.name: Jewel Of The Nile
steps: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients.
Stir well.
Strain into a cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Jitterbug
steps: Wet glass, dip rim in sugar.
Then add Ice.
Then add everything else.
It's that simple!

cocktails.name: John Collins
steps: Pour all ingredients directly into highball glass filled with ice.
Stir gently.
Garnish.
Add a dash of Angostura bitters.

cocktails.name: Jungle Bird
cocktails.garnish: pineapple wedge, Luxardo cherry, mint sprig
cocktails.lore: The Jungle Bird was created in 1978 at the Aviary Bar in the Kuala Lumpur Hilton — a rare tiki cocktail from Southeast Asia rather than the American tiki bar tradition. It was the hotel's welcome cocktail. After disappearing for decades, it was rediscovered by Jeff 'Beachbum' Berry in 2004 and has since become a modern classic.
cocktails.proTip: Use Campari without hesitation — it sounds wrong in a fruity tropical drink, but the bitter counterpoint is exactly what keeps the pineapple from becoming cloying.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a cocktail shaker.
Fill with ice and shake vigorously for 12–15 seconds until well-chilled.
Strain into your prepared glass.
Garnish with pineapple wedge, Luxardo cherry, mint sprig.

cocktails.name: Just a Moonmint
steps: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended.
Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up.

cocktails.name: Kamikaze
steps: Shake all ingredients together with ice.
Strain into glass, garnish and serve.

cocktails.name: Karsk
steps: Put a copper coin in a coffe-cup and fill up with coffee until you no longer see the coin, then add alcohol until you see the coin.
Norwegian speciality.

cocktails.name: Kentucky B And B
steps: Pour the bourbon and Benedictine into a brandy snifter.

cocktails.name: Kentucky Colonel
steps: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes combine the courbon and Benedictine.
Shake and strain into a cocktail glass.
Garnish with the lemon twist.

cocktails.name: Kill the cold Smoothie
steps: Juice ginger and lemon and add it to hot water.
You may add cardomom.

cocktails.name: Kioki Coffee
steps: Stir.
Add whipped cream to the top.

cocktails.name: Kir
steps: Add the crème de cassis to the bottom of the glass, then top up with wine.

cocktails.name: Kir Royale
steps: Pour Creme de cassis in glass, gently pour champagne on top.

cocktails.name: Kiss me Quick
steps: mix in the glass.

cocktails.name: Kiwi Lemon
steps: Mix in highball glass.
Stirr.
Garnish with slice of kiwi.

cocktails.name: Kiwi Martini
steps: The kiwi martini is a very fun vodka cocktail and it is one of the best drinks that makes use of fresh fruit.
Though there are a few recipes floating around, this is one of the easiest and it is an absolutely delightful green martini to drink.
For this recipe, you'll simply muddle slices of kiwi with simple syrup, then shake it with vodka.
It's a drink that anyone can mix up in minutes and a perfect cocktail to show off your favorite vodka.

cocktails.name: Kiwi Papaya Smoothie
steps: Throw everything into a blender and liquify.

cocktails.name: Kool First Aid
steps: Add Kool Aid to a double shot glass, and top with rum.
Slam and shoot.

cocktails.name: Kool-Aid Shot
steps: Pour into a large glass with ice and stir.
Add a little cranberry juice to taste.

cocktails.name: Kool-Aid Slammer
steps: Fill half the shot glass with the kool-aid first.
Then put a paper towel over the top of the glass and slowly pour in the vodka.
If you do it right, you should be able to see that the two liquids are separated, with the vodka on top.
Now slam it!
The last thing you'll taste is the kool-aid.

cocktails.name: Kurant Tea
steps: Pour Absolut Kurant into a comfortably big tea-cup.
Add the not too hot(!) apple tea and, if you like, some sugar.
Enjoy!

cocktails.name: Lady Love Fizz
steps: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass over two ice cubes.
Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

cocktails.name: Lassi - A South Indian Drink
steps: Blend in a blender for 3 seconds.
Lassi is one of the easiest things to make, and there are many ways of making it.
Basically, it is buttermilk (yoghurt whisked with water), and you can choose almost any consistency that you like, from the thinnest to the thickest.
Serve cold.

cocktails.name: Lassi - Mango
steps: Put it all in a blender and pour over crushed ice.
You can also use other fruits like strawberries and bananas.

cocktails.name: Lassi - Sweet
steps: Put all ingredients into a blender and blend until nice and frothy.
Serve chilled.

cocktails.name: Lassi Khara
steps: Blend (frappe) in blender until frothy.
Add torn curry leaves and serve cold.

cocktails.name: Lassi Raita
steps: Blend the yoghurt and ice cubes together, until the yoghurt becomes more liquid.
Add sugar to taste.
The lemon/lime is optional but it gives it a slightly tart taste.
Dash of salt.
Raita is also good for the summer.
Instead of having a traditional salad you can make raita instead.

cocktails.name: Last Word
cocktails.lore: The Last Word originated at the Detroit Athletic Club around 1916 and was documented in Ted Saucier's 1951 book 'Bottoms Up.' It then vanished for decades until Murray Stenson of Zig Zag Café in Seattle revived it in 2004, sparking the cocktail revival's love affair with equal-parts drinks and forgotten pre-Prohibition recipes.
cocktails.proTip: Chartreuse Green is irreplaceable — there's nothing else with that particular herbal complexity. Don't substitute Yellow Chartreuse; it's a different drink.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a cocktail shaker.
Fill with ice and shake vigorously for 12–15 seconds until well-chilled.
Strain into your prepared glass.
Garnish with Luxardo cherry.

cocktails.name: Lazy Coconut Paloma
cocktails.garnish: large grapefruit slice against the inside of the glass
steps: Mix the coconut liqueur (preferably tequila) with the grapefruit juice and top with soda water.
Garnish with a large grapefruit slice against the inside of the glass.

cocktails.name: Lemon Drop
steps: Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass rimmed with sugar.

cocktails.name: Lemon Elderflower Spritzer
steps: Pour all ingredients over ice, stir and enjoy!

cocktails.name: Lemon Shot
steps: Mix Galliano and Absolut Citron in a shot glass, lay lemon wedge sprinkled with sugar over glass and pour a rum over wedge and glass. light rum with a lighter and let burn for a second.
Do shot quickly and suck on lemon.
If it is done correctly, this will taste like a shot of sweet lemonade.

cocktails.name: Lemouroudji
steps: Juice the lemons.
Peel and grate the ginger.
Place the grated ginger and a liberal dash of the cayenne pepper into a piece of cheesecloth, and tie it into a knot.
Let soak in the water.
After 15 minutes or so, add the sugar, and the lemon juice.
Chill, and serve.

cocktails.name: Limeade
steps: In a large glass, put the lime juice and sugar, and stir well.
Add cold seltzer water to fill.
Put the lime peels in the glass.
Drink.
Repeat until limes or soda run out.

cocktails.name: Limona Corona
steps: Open the Corona.
Fill the empty space in the neck in the bottle with the rum.
The bottle should be filled to the top.
Plug the bottle with your thumb or the palm of your hand.
Turn the bottle upside-down so the rum and beer mix.
Turn the bottle rightside-up, unplug, and drink.

cocktails.name: Loch Lomond
steps: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine the Scotch, Drambuie, and vermouth.
Stir well.
Strain into a cocktail glass.
Garnish with the lemon twist.

cocktails.name: London Town
steps: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients.
Stir well.
Strain into a cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Lone Tree Cocktail
steps: Stir ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktails.name: Lone Tree Cooler
steps: Stir powdered sugar and 2 oz. carbonated water in a collins glass.
Fill glass with ice, add gin and vermouth, and stir.
Fill with carbonated water and stir again.
Add the twist of lemon peel and the orange spiral so that the end dangles over rim of glass.

cocktails.name: Long Island Iced Tea
steps: Mix all contents in a highball glass and sitr gently.
Add dash of Coca-Cola for the coloring and garnish with lemon or lime twist.

cocktails.name: Long Island Tea
steps: Combine all ingredients (except cola) and pour over ice in a highball glass.
Add the splash of cola for color.
Decorate with a slice of lemon and serve.

cocktails.name: Long vodka
steps: Shake a tall glass with ice cubes and Angostura, coating the inside of the glass.
Por the vodka onto this, add 1 slice of lime and squeeze juice out of remainder, mix with tonic, stir and voila you have a Long Vodka.

cocktails.name: Lord And Lady
steps: Pour the rum and Tia Maria into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes.
Stir well.

cocktails.name: Lunch Box
steps: Fill a pint glass almost full with beer.
Then fill the rest with orange juice (careful not to fill it to the top).
Then take the shot of Amaretto and drop it in.

cocktails.name: Mai Tai
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice.
Strain into glass.
Garnish and serve with straw.

cocktails.name: Malibu Twister
steps: Add rum & trister then, add cranberry jucie,stir.

cocktails.name: Mango Mojito
steps: Squeeze the juice from 1½ limes and blend with the mango to give a smooth purée.
Cut the rest of the limes into quarters, and then cut each wedge in half again.
Put 2 pieces of lime in a highball glass for each person and add 1 teaspoon of caster sugar and 5-6 mint leaves to each glass.
Squish everything together with a muddler or the end of a rolling pin to release all the flavours from the lime and mint.
Divide the mango purée between the glasses and add 30ml white rum and a handful of crushed ice to each one, stirring well to mix everything together.
Top up with soda water to serve and garnish with extra mint, if you like.

cocktails.name: Mango Orange Smoothie
steps: Throw everything into a blender and liquify.

cocktails.name: Manhattan
cocktails.lore: Legend holds that the Manhattan was invented at New York's Manhattan Club in 1874 at a banquet hosted by Lady Randolph Churchill (Winston's mother) for presidential candidate Samuel Tilden. Historians now doubt this story — Lady Churchill was pregnant and in England at the time — but the drink itself is undeniably New York in its DNA.
cocktails.proTip: Use Carpano Antica Formula for a richer, more complex Manhattan. And never, ever shake it — a Manhattan should be silky, not frothy.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a mixing glass.
Fill with large ice cubes and stir steadily for 30 seconds.
Strain into your chilled glass.
Garnish with Luxardo cherry, expressed orange peel.

cocktails.name: Margarita
cocktails.lore: The Margarita's true origin is contested — at least a dozen people claim to have invented it between the 1930s and 1950s. The most cited story involves socialite Margarita Sames, who mixed the drink for guests at her Acapulco villa in 1948. Whether true or not, by the 1970s it had become the best-selling cocktail in the United States.
cocktails.proTip: Tommy's variation (swap Cointreau for ½ oz agave syrup) is often considered the superior recipe — it lets the tequila shine and is less sweet.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a cocktail shaker.
Fill with ice and shake vigorously for 12–15 seconds until well-chilled.
Strain into your prepared glass.
Garnish with half salt rim, lime wheel.

cocktails.name: Martinez 2
steps: Add all ingredients to a mixing glass and fill with ice.
Stir until chilled, and strain into a chilled coupe glass.

cocktails.name: Martinez Cocktail
steps: Stir all ingredients (except cherry) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass.
Top with the cherry and serve.

cocktails.name: Martini
steps: Straight: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes.
Stir well.
Strain in chilled martini cocktail glass.
Squeeze oil from lemon peel onto the drink, or garnish with olive.

cocktails.name: Mary Pickford
steps: Shake and strain into a chilled large cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Masala Chai
steps: Bring 2 cups of water to boil.
Add all the ingredients and boil again for about 15 seconds.
Let stand for a minute.
Warm milk in a pot.
Filter tea into cups.
Add milk and sugar.
That's IT.

cocktails.name: Mauresque
steps: Pour the Ricard (or pastis).
Pour the orgeat syrup.
Finally pour the water and add ice cubes at your convenience.
Add the ice cubes at the end, otherwise the syrup and pastis do not mix well.

cocktails.name: Melya
steps: Brew espresso.
In a coffee mug, place 1 teaspoon of unsweetened powdered cocoa, then cover a teaspoon with honey and drizzle it into the cup.
Stir while the coffee brews, this is the fun part.
The cocoa seems to coat the honey without mixing, so you get a dusty, sticky mass that looks as though it will never mix.
Then all at once, presto!
It looks like dark chocolate sauce.
Pour hot espresso over the honey, stirring to dissolve.
Serve with cream.

cocktails.name: Miami Vice
steps: First: Mix pina colada with 2.5 oz. of rum with ice(set aside).
Second: Mix daiquiri with 2.5 oz. of rum with ice.
Third: While frozen, add pina colda mix then daiquiri mix in glass (Making sure they do not get mixed together).

cocktails.name: Michelada
steps: Mix the beer with tomato juice, freshly squeezed lime juice, and Worcestershire sauce, teriyaki sauce, soy sauce, or hot sauce.
Served In a chilled, salt-rimmed glass.

cocktails.name: Microwave Hot Cocoa
steps: Combine sugar, cocoa, salt and hot water in 1-quart micro-proof measuring cup (or coffee mug).
Microwave at HIGH (100%) for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until boiling.
Add milk, sitr and microwave an additonal 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until hot.
Stir in vanilla, blend well.

cocktails.name: Midnight Cowboy
steps: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients.
Shake well.
Strain into a cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Midnight Manx
steps: Fill a mixer with ice and add Baileys, Kahlua, Goldshlager, and cream.
Shake for 5 seconds and Strain into a double rocks glass filled with ice.
Add chilled coffee Stir and enjoy!

cocktails.name: Midnight Mint
steps: If available, rim cocktail (Martini) glass with sugar syrup then dip into chocolate flakes or powder.
Add ingredients into shaker with ice.
Shake well then strain into cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Mimosa
steps: Ensure both ingredients are well chilled, then mix into the glass.
Serve cold.

cocktails.name: Mint Julep
steps: In a highball glass gently muddle the mint, sugar and water.
Fill the glass with cracked ice, add Bourbon and stir well until the glass is well frosted.
Garnish with a mint sprig.

cocktails.name: Mississippi Planters Punch
steps: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a collins glass over ice cubes.
Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

cocktails.name: Mocha-Berry
steps: pour 6 oz. of coffee in a mug or Irish coffee cup. add coca mix and chambord, mix well and top off with whipped cream.

cocktails.name: Mojito
cocktails.lore: The Mojito's roots trace back to 16th-century Cuba, where a similar drink called 'El Draque' was made with aguardiente (a precursor to rum), lime, sugar, and mint. When the sugar cane industry introduced proper rum, the recipe evolved into what we know today. It became internationally famous as Hemingway's drink of choice at La Bodeguita del Medio in Havana.
cocktails.proTip: Gently press (don't shred) the mint with the syrup and lime juice. Over-muddling tears the leaves and releases bitter chlorophyll instead of fragrant oils.
steps: Fill your glass with ice.
Add ingredients in order, finishing with any carbonated components.
Give a single gentle stir to incorporate.
Garnish with slapped mint sprig, lime wheel.

cocktails.name: Mojito Extra
steps: Put mint with lemon juice in a glas, mash the mint with a spoon, ice, rum & fill up with club soda.
Top it with Angostura.

cocktails.name: Monkey Gland
steps: Shake well over ice cubes in a shaker, strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Monkey Wrench
steps: Pour all of the ingredients into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes.
Stir well.

cocktails.name: Moranguito
steps: first you put rhe absinthe, then put tequila, then put the Granadine syrup.

cocktails.name: Moscow Mule
cocktails.lore: The Moscow Mule was born out of a marketing stunt in 1941. John Martin had just bought the rights to Smirnoff vodka (nearly unknown in the US at the time) and met Jack Morgan, who owned Cock 'n' Bull ginger beer and had a warehouse of copper mugs he couldn't sell. They combined forces and created the Moscow Mule as a promotional vehicle for all three products. It worked.
cocktails.proTip: The copper mug isn't just theatrical — it keeps the ice colder longer and subtly changes the metal-ion flavor profile. Use a quality spicy ginger beer, not ginger ale.
steps: Fill your glass with ice.
Add ingredients in order, finishing with any carbonated components.
Give a single gentle stir to incorporate.
Garnish with lime wheel, candied ginger.

cocktails.name: Mother's Milk
steps: Shake over ice, strain.
Serves two.

cocktails.name: Mountain Bramble
steps: Muddle the blackberries in a tumbler glass.
Mix the Gin, lemon juice and sugar syrup in a shaker and strain over chopped ice.
Top with Soda water and garnish with more blackberries and some mint.

cocktails.name: Mudslinger
steps: Add all contents to a large jug or punch bowl.
Stir well!

cocktails.name: Mulled Wine
steps: Simmer 3 cups water with, sugar, cloves, cinnamon sticks, and lemon peel in a stainless steel pot for 10 minutes.
Add wine heat to a "coffee temperature" (DO NOT BOIL) then add the brandy.

cocktails.name: Munich Mule
steps: Fill glass with ice.
Pour Gin and Lime Juice.
Fill glass with Ginger Beer.
Garnish with Cucumer and Lime slice.

cocktails.name: National Aquarium
steps: Pour all ingredients into a shaker of ice.
Shake well.
Serve on the rocks.

cocktails.name: Negroni
cocktails.lore: Count Camillo Negroni walked into Café Casoni in Florence, Italy, in 1919 and asked bartender Fosco Scarselli to strengthen his Americano by replacing the soda water with gin. The bartender obliged and garnished it with an orange peel instead of lemon to distinguish it from the original. A cocktail dynasty was born.
cocktails.proTip: The equal-parts ratio is intentional. Resist the urge to add more gin — the tension between spirit, bitter, and sweet is the whole point.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a mixing glass.
Fill with large ice cubes and stir steadily for 30 seconds.
Strain into your chilled glass.
Garnish with orange twist.

cocktails.name: New York Lemonade
steps: Serve in a chilled cocktail glass.
Lemon and sugar the rim.
Stir and Strain.

cocktails.name: New York Sour
steps: Shake blended whiskey, juice of lemon, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass.
Float claret on top.
Decorate with the half-slice of lemon and the cherry and serve.

cocktails.name: Nuked Hot Chocolate
steps: Mix with a bit of milk (1 oz or so) in coffee mug.
Nuke mug for about 30-50 seconds.
Stir until the heated cocoa dissolves.
Fill mug with milk.
Nuke for 1-2 minutes, depending on wattage and preferences as to burnt mouth parts.

cocktails.name: Nutty Irishman
steps: Serve over ice.

cocktails.name: Oatmeal Cookie
steps: Just mix it all together.
It's meant to be a shot, but it works just fine as a proper adult-sized drink over lots of ice.
Tastes like an oatmeal cookie.

cocktails.name: Old Cuban
steps: Shake a handful of mint, 2oz white rum, 1oz of sugar syrup, 1oz lime juice and 2 dashes angostura bitters with ice.
Double strain into a glass and top with 2oz of prosecco.

cocktails.name: Old Fashioned
cocktails.lore: The Old Fashioned is arguably the original cocktail — the word 'cocktail' was first defined in 1806 as a spirit, sugar, water, and bitters. When bartenders in the late 1800s began adding elaborate liqueurs, a segment of drinkers asked for their drinks made 'the old-fashioned way.' The name stuck.
cocktails.proTip: Use a barspoon and stir for a full 30 seconds. Under-stirring is the most common mistake with this drink — proper dilution and temperature are everything.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a mixing glass.
Fill with large ice cubes and stir steadily for 30 seconds.
Strain into your chilled glass.
Garnish with expressed orange peel, cocktail cherry.

ingredients.name: bourbon
ingredients.notes: Buffalo Trace or Woodford Reserve recommended

cocktails.name: Old Pal
steps: Chill cocktail glass.
Add ingredients to a mixing glass, and fill 2/3 full with ice.
Stir about 20 seconds.
Empty cocktail glass and strain into the glass.
Garnish with a twist of lemon peel.

cocktails.name: Orange Crush
steps: Add all ingredients to tumbler-Pour as shot.

cocktails.name: Orange Oasis
steps: Shake brandy, gin, and orange juice with ice and strain into a highball glass over ice cubes.
Fill with ginger ale, stir, and serve.

cocktails.name: Orange Push-up
steps: Combine liquors in a blender.
Add a half scoop of ice and blend.
Garnish with an orange and cherry flag.
So good it will melt in your mouth!!!

cocktails.name: Orange Rosemary Collins
cocktails.garnish: orange slices inside the glass as well as some rosemary on top
steps: Add the spirits to the bottom of the glass and top equally with the mixer drinks.
Garnish with orange slices inside the glass as well as some rosemary on top.

cocktails.name: Orange Scented Hot Chocolate
steps: Combine all ingredients in heavy medium saucepan.
Stir over low heat until chocolate melts.
Increase heat and bring just to a boil, stirring often.
Remove from heat and whisk untily frothy.
Return to heat and bring to boil again.
Remove from heat, whisk until frothy.
Repeat heating and whisking once again.
Discard orange peel. (Can be prepared 2 hours ahead.
Let stand at room temperature.
Before serving, bring just to boil, remove from heat and whisk until frothy.) Pour hot chocolate into coffee mugs.
Makes 2 servings.

cocktails.name: Orange Whip
steps: Pour ingredients over ice and stir.

cocktails.name: Orangeade
steps: Place some ice cubes in a large tumbler or highball glass, add lemon juice, orange juice, sugar syrup, and stir well.
Top up with cold soda water, serve with a drinking straw.

cocktails.name: Oreo Mudslide
steps: Blend Vodka, Kahlua, Bailey's, ice-cream and the Oreo well in a blender.
Pour into a large frosted glass.
Garnish with whipped cream and a cherry.

cocktails.name: Orgasm
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a chilled cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktails.name: Owen's Grandmother's Revenge
steps: Add ingredients and mix in blender.

cocktails.name: Paloma
cocktails.lore: The Paloma is Mexico's most popular tequila cocktail — more popular than the Margarita within Mexico itself. 'Paloma' means dove in Spanish, though the exact origin of the name is unclear. It's thought to have been created in the 1950s or 60s, possibly by Don Javier Delgado Corona at his bar La Capilla in Tequila, Mexico — who also invented the Batanga.
cocktails.proTip: Fresh grapefruit juice (2 oz) plus a splash of soda is better than grapefruit soda alone — more depth, less sweetness, and you control the balance.
steps: Fill your glass with ice.
Add ingredients in order, finishing with any carbonated components.
Give a single gentle stir to incorporate.
Garnish with grapefruit wedge, salted rim.

cocktails.name: Paper Plane
cocktails.lore: Created by Sam Ross at Milk & Honey in New York in 2007, the Paper Plane is a modern equal-parts cocktail that became an instant classic. Named after the M.I.A. song that was playing when Ross was developing the recipe, it demonstrated that a genuinely new template — not just a riff on an old one — could still be invented.
cocktails.proTip: The equal-parts format is non-negotiable. Every element is load-bearing. Substituting any ingredient collapses the balance.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a cocktail shaker.
Fill with ice and shake vigorously for 12–15 seconds until well-chilled.
Strain into your prepared glass.
Garnish with no garnish.

cocktails.name: Paradise
steps: Shake together over ice.
Strain into cocktail glass and serve chilled.

cocktails.name: Passion Fruit Martini
steps: Pour all ingredients into a glass and stir.
Garnish with half a passion fruit piece.

cocktails.name: Pegu Club
steps: Shake, strain, up, cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Penicillin
steps: Shake blended Scotch, lemon juice, honey syrup and ginger syrup with ice.
Strain over large ice in chilled rocks glass.
Float smoky Scotch on top (be sure to use a smoky Scotch such as an Islay single malt).
Garnish with candied ginger.

cocktails.name: Pina Colada
steps: Mix with crushed ice in blender until smooth.
Pour into chilled glass, garnish and serve.

cocktails.name: Pineapple Gingerale Smoothie
steps: Throw everything into a blender and liquify.

cocktails.name: Pineapple Paloma
steps: Rub the rim of each glass with lime slice and dip into salt.
Add ice, tequila, grapefruit juice, lime juice and top with pineapple soda.
Give it a quick stir.
Garnish with fresh pineapple or lime.

cocktails.name: Pink Gin
steps: Pour the bitters into a wine glass.
Swirl the glass to coat the inside with the bitters, shake out the excess.
Pour the gin into the glass.
Do not add ice.

cocktails.name: Pink Lady
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktails.name: Pink Moon
steps: Slowly shake in a shaker with ice, strain into a square whiskey glass.
Top with fresh ice.
Add the blackberries to garnish.
Add flowers and a green leaf for a special look!

cocktails.name: Pink Panty Pulldowns
steps: Shake well.

cocktails.name: Pink Penocha
steps: mix all ingredients into bowl keep iced stir frequently.

cocktails.name: Pisco Sour
steps: Vigorously shake and strain contents in a cocktail shaker with ice cubes, then pour into glass and garnish with bitters.

cocktails.name: Planter's Punch
steps: Pour all ingredients, except the bitters, into shaker filled with ice.
Shake well.
Pour into large glass, filled with ice.
Add Angostura bitters, "on top".
Garnish with cocktail cherry and pineapple.

cocktails.name: Popped cherry
steps: Served over ice in a tall glass with a popped cherry (can add more popped cherries if in the mood)!

cocktails.name: Poppy Cocktail
steps: Shake ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktails.name: Pornstar Martini
steps: Straight: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes.
Shake well.
Strain in chilled martini cocktail glass.
Cut passion fruit in half and use as garnish.
Pour prosecco into a chilled shot glass and serve alongside the martini.

cocktails.name: Port And Starboard
steps: Pour carefully into a pousse-cafe glass, so that creme de menthe floats on grenadine.
Serve without mixing.

cocktails.name: Port Wine Cocktail
steps: Stir ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktails.name: Port Wine Flip
steps: Shake all ingredients (except nutmeg) with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass.
Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.

cocktails.name: Porto flip
steps: Shake ingredients together in a mixer with ice.
Strain into glass, garnish and serve.

cocktails.name: Pure Passion
steps: Mix up all ingredients with a cocktail stirrer and serve with crushed ice with mint and edible flour if available.

cocktails.name: Pysch Vitamin Light
steps: Shake with ice.

cocktails.name: Quaker's Cocktail
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktails.name: Quarter Deck Cocktail
steps: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktails.name: Queen Bee
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktails.name: Queen Charlotte
steps: Pour red wine and grenadine into a collins glass over ice cubes.
Fill with lemon-lime soda, stir, and serve.

cocktails.name: Queen Elizabeth
steps: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktails.name: Quentin
steps: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the rum, Kahlua, and cream.
Shake well.
Strain into a cocktail glass and garnish with the nutmeg.

cocktails.name: Quick F**K
steps: In a shot glass add 1/3 Kahlua first.
Then 1/3 Miduri, topping it off with a 1/3 bailey's irish cream.

cocktails.name: Quick-sand
steps: Simply add the orange juice, quite a quick pour in order to mix the sambucca with the orange juice.
The juice MUST have fruit pulp!

cocktails.name: Radioactive Long Island Iced Tea
steps: Pour all ingredients over ice in a very tall glass.
Sip cautiously.

cocktails.name: Radler
steps: Pour beer into large mug, slowly add the 7-up (or Sprite).

cocktails.name: Rail Splitter
steps: Mix sugar syrup with lemon juice in a tall glass.
Fill up with ginger ale.

cocktails.name: Ramos Gin Fizz
steps: Prepare all the ingredients on the counter to be able to work well and quickly, especially the cream and egg white.
Pour all the ingredients into a shaker.
Shake vigorously for 1 minute: cream and egg white must be mixed perfectly, so don't rush.
Now open the shaker and put some ice and shake for 1-2 minutes.
It depends on how long you can resist!
Pour into a highball glass, add a splash of soda and garnish to taste.
Ramos Gin Fizz was once drunk as an invigorating drink or even as a breakfast, try it as an aperitif and after dinner and you will discover a little gem now lost.

cocktails.name: Raspberry Cooler
steps: Pour the raspberry vodka and soda into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes.
Stir well.

cocktails.name: Raspberry Julep
steps: Softly muddle the mint leaves and raspberry syrup in the bottom of the cup.
Add crushed ice and Bourbon to the cup and then stir.
Top with more ice, garnish with a mint sprig.

cocktails.name: Red Snapper
steps: One shot each, shake n shoot.

cocktails.name: Rose
steps: Shake together in a cocktail shaker, then strain into chilled glass.
Garnish and serve.

cocktails.name: Rosemary Blue
steps: Add the Bombay Sapphire, Blue Curacao, rosemary sprig and gently squeezed lemon wedge to a balloon glass.
Swirl well to combine.
Fill with cubed ice and top with the Fever-Tree Light Tonic Water.
Gently fold with a bar spoon to mix.

cocktails.name: Royal Bitch
steps: Into a shot glass layer the Crown Royal on top of the Frangelico.

cocktails.name: Royal Fizz
steps: Shake all ingredients (except cola) with ice and strain into a chilled collins glass.
Fill with cola and serve.

cocktails.name: Royal Flush
steps: Pour all the ingredients into tumbler over ice.
Strain into glass.

cocktails.name: Royal Gin Fizz
steps: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes.
Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

cocktails.name: Ruby Tuesday
steps: Pour gin and cranberry into a highball filled with ice cubes.
Add grenadine and stir.

cocktails.name: Rum Cobbler
cocktails.garnish: cherry and the orange and lemon slices
steps: In an old-fashioned glass, dissolve the sugar in the club soda.
Add crushed ice until the glass is almost full.
Add the rum.
Stir well.
Garnish with the cherry and the orange and lemon slices.

cocktails.name: Rum Cooler
steps: Pour the rum and soda into a collins glass almost filled with ice cubes.
Stir well and garnish with the lemon wedge.

cocktails.name: Rum Milk Punch
steps: Shake all ingredients (except nutmeg) with ice and strain into a collins glass.
Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.

cocktails.name: Rum Old-fashioned
steps: Stir powdered sugar, water, and bitters in an old-fashioned glass.
When sugar has dissolved add ice cubes and light rum.
Add the twist of lime peel, float 151 proof rum on top, and serve.

cocktails.name: Rum Punch
steps: Mix all ingredients in a punch bowl and serve.

cocktails.name: Rum Runner
steps: Mix all ingredients in glass & add ice.

cocktails.name: Rum Screwdriver
steps: Pour rum into a highball glass over ice cubes.
Add orange juice, stir, and serve.

cocktails.name: Rum Sour
steps: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the rum, lemon juice, and sugar.
Shake well.
Strain into a sour glass and garnish with the orange slice and the cherry.

cocktails.name: Rum Toddy
steps: Dissolve powdered sugar in water in an old-fashioned glass.
Add rum and one ice cube and stir.
Add the twist of lemon peel and serve.

cocktails.name: Russian Spring Punch
steps: Pour the ingredients into an highball glass, top with Sparkling wine.

cocktails.name: Rusty Nail
steps: Pour the Scotch and Drambuie into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes.
Stir well.
Garnish with the lemon twist.

cocktails.name: Salty Dog
steps: Pour all ingredients over ice cubes in a highball glass.
Stir well and serve. (Vodka may be substituted for gin, if preferred.).

cocktails.name: San Francisco
steps: Take a tall glass and put in a few ice cubes, fill the vodka over it and fill with juice then the "creme", to end fill in the grenadine but very carefully at the side of the glass so it will lay down in the bottom. garnish with orange and strawberry.

cocktails.name: Sangria
steps: Mix all together in a pitcher and refrigerate.
Add cloves and cinnamon sticks to taste.
Serve in wine glasses.

cocktails.name: Sangria The  Best
steps: Mix wine, sugar and fruit, and let sit in the fridge for 18-24 hours.
The mixture will have a somewhat syrupy consistency.
Before serving stir in brandy and cut the mixture with soda water until it have a thinner, more wine like consistency.
Serve from a pitcher in wine glasses.

cocktails.name: Sazerac
cocktails.garnish: expressed lemon peel (discarded), no garnish in glass
cocktails.lore: The Sazerac is one of the oldest known American cocktails, originating in New Orleans in the 1830s at the Sazerac Coffee House. Originally made with Cognac, a phylloxera epidemic that devastated French vineyards forced a switch to rye whiskey. In 2008, the Louisiana State Legislature officially recognized it as New Orleans' official cocktail.
cocktails.proTip: Chill the serving glass with ice water, discard the water, rinse with absinthe, then discard the absinthe — just the residue remains. This aromatic ghost is central to the drink.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a mixing glass.
Fill with large ice cubes and stir steadily for 30 seconds.
Strain into your chilled glass.
Garnish with expressed lemon peel (discarded), no garnish in glass.

cocktails.name: Scooter
steps: Shake all ingredients well with cracked ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktails.name: Scotch Cobbler
steps: Pour scotch, brandy, and curacao over ice in an old-fashioned glass.
Add the orange slice, top with the mint sprig, and serve.

cocktails.name: Scotch Sour
steps: Shake scotch, juice of lime, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass.
Decorate with 1/2 slice lemon, top with the cherry, and serve.

cocktails.name: Scottish Highland Liqueur
steps: Combine all ingreds in aging container.
Cover tightly and shake gently several times during the first 24 hrs.
After 24 hrs, remove the lemon zest.
Cover again and let stand in a cool, dark place for 2 weeks, shaking gently every other day.
Strain through a wire sieve to remove the angelica root and fennel.
Return to aging container, cover and let stand undisturbed in a cool dark place for 6 months.
Siphon or pour clear liqueur into a sterile bottle.
The cloudy dregs may be saved for cooking.

cocktails.name: Screwdriver
steps: Mix in a highball glass with ice.
Garnish and serve.

cocktails.name: Sea breeze
steps: Build all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.
Garnish with lime wedge.

cocktails.name: Shark Attack
steps: Mix lemonade and water according to instructions on back of can.
If the instructions say to add 4 1/3 cans of water do so.
Mix into pitcher.
Add 1 1/2 cup of Vodka (Absolut).
Mix well.
Pour into glass of crushed ice.
Excellent!

cocktails.name: Sherry Eggnog
steps: Shake sherry, powdered sugar, and egg with ice and strain into a collins glass.
Fill with milk and stir.
Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.

cocktails.name: Sherry Flip
steps: Shake all ingredients (except nutmeg) with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass.
Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.

cocktails.name: Shot-gun
steps: Pour one part Jack Daneils and one part Jim Beam into shot glass then float Wild Turkey on top.

cocktails.name: Sidecar
steps: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice.
Shake well and strain into cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Slippery Nipple
steps: Pour the Sambuca into a shot glass, then pour the Irish Cream on top so that the two liquids do not mix.

cocktails.name: Smashed Watermelon Margarita
cocktails.garnish: fresh mint and a small slice of watermelon
steps: In a mason jar muddle the watermelon and 5 mint leaves together into a puree and strain.
Next add the grapefruit juice, juice of half a lime and the tequila as well as some ice.
Put a lid on the jar and shake.
Pour into a glass and add more ice.
Garnish with fresh mint and a small slice of watermelon.

cocktails.name: Smut
steps: Throw it all together and serve real cold.

cocktails.name: Snake Bite (UK)
steps: Pour ingredients into a pint glass.
Drink.
Fall over.

cocktails.name: Snakebite and Black
steps: Put blackcurrant squash in first up to about 1cm in glass.
Then add the lager and cider one after another.

cocktails.name: Snowball
steps: Place one ice cube in the glass and add 1 1/2 oz of Advocaat.
Fill up the glass with lemonade and decorate with a slice of lemon.
Serve at once.

cocktails.name: Snowday
steps: Stir all ingredients with ice.
Strain into a chilled rocks glass over fresh ice.
Express orange peel over drink and garnish.

cocktails.name: Sol Y Sombra
steps: Shake ingredients with ice, strain into a brandy snifter, and serve. (The English translation of the name of this drink is "Sun and Shade", and after sampling this drink, you'll understand why.
Thanks, Kirby.).

cocktails.name: Space Odyssey
steps: Fill glass with ice and add shots of Bacardi and Malibu.
Add splash of pineapple juice and top with orange juice.
Add grenadine for color and garnish with cherries.

cocktails.name: Spanish chocolate
steps: Stir the milk with the chocolate and the cinnamon over low heat until the chocolate dissolves.
Add the eggs and beat the mixture until it becomes thick, taking care not to boil.
Serve in coffee mug.

cocktails.name: Spice 75
steps: Gently warm 60g golden caster sugar in a pan with 30ml water and 1 tbsp allspice.
Cook gently until the sugar has dissolved, then leave the mixture to cool.
Strain through a sieve lined with a coffee filter (or a double layer of kitchen paper).
Pour 60ml of the spiced syrup into a cocktail shaker along with 200ml rum and 90ml lime juice.
Shake with ice and strain between six flute glasses.
Top up with 600ml champagne and garnish each with an orange twist.

cocktails.name: Spiced Peach Punch
steps: Combine peach nectar, orange juice and brown sugar in a large saucepan.
Tie cinnamon and cloves in a small cheesecloth bag.
Drop into saucepan.
Heat slowly, stirring constantly, until sugar dissolves.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in lime juice.
Serve in hot mugs.

cocktails.name: Spiking coffee
steps: Incidentally, a pinch of cinnamon is indeed a nice addition to coffee but true heaven is a cardamom seed.
Of course, you serve it in a coffee mug.

cocktails.name: Spritz
steps: Build into glass over ice, garnish and serve.

cocktails.name: Spritz Veneziano
steps: Build into glass over ice, garnish and serve.

cocktails.name: Stinger
steps: Pour in a mixing glass with ice, stir and strain into a cocktail glass.
May also be served on rocks in a rocks glass.

cocktails.name: Stone Sour
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a chilled whiskey sour glass, and serve.

cocktails.name: Strawberry Lemonade
steps: Throw everything into a blender and mix until fairly smooth.
Serve over ice.

cocktails.name: Strawberry Shivers
steps: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended.
Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up.

cocktails.name: Sunny Holiday Punch
steps: Combine all ingredients in a punch bowl.

cocktails.name: Swedish Coffee
steps: Pour the coffee in an ordinary coffee cup.
Add the aquavit.
Add sugar by taste.
Stir and have a nice evening (morning).

cocktails.name: Sweet Bananas
steps: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended.
Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up.

cocktails.name: Sweet Sangria
steps: Dissolve the sugar in hot water and cool.
Peel the citrus fruits and break into wedges.
Mix the wine, sugar syrup, fruit, and Fresca in a pitcher and put in the fridge for a few hours.
Serve in tall glasses with a straw.

cocktails.name: Sweet Tooth
steps: Put 2 shots Godiva Liquour into a glass, add as much or as little milk as you would like.

cocktails.name: Talos Coffee
steps: Add your GM and then add your coffee.

cocktails.name: Tennesee Mud
steps: Mix Coffee, Jack Daniels and Amaretto.
Add Cream on top.

cocktails.name: Tequila Fizz
steps: Shake all ingredients (except ginger ale) with ice and strain into a collins glass over ice cubes.
Fill with ginger ale, stir, and serve.

cocktails.name: Tequila Slammer
steps: Mix carefully to avoid releasing the dissolved CO2.

cocktails.name: Tequila Sour
steps: Shake tequila, juice of lemon, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass.
Add the half-slice of lemon, top with the cherry, and serve.

cocktails.name: Tequila Sunrise
steps: Pour the tequila and orange juice into glass over ice.
Add the grenadine, which will sink to the bottom.
Stir gently to create the sunrise effect.
Garnish and serve.

cocktails.name: Tequila Surprise
steps: Fill shot glass with Tequila.
Add drops of Tobasco sauce.

cocktails.name: Texas Rattlesnake
steps: Mix all ingredients and Shake well.
Sweet at first, with a BITE at the end...

cocktails.name: Texas Sling
steps: Blend with Ice until smooth.
Serve in a tulip glass, top with whip cream.

cocktails.name: Thai Coffee
steps: Place the coffee and spices in the filter cone of your coffee maker.
Brew coffee as usual, let it cool.
In a tall glass, dissolve 1 or 2 teaspoons of sugar in an ounce of the coffee (it's easier to dissolve than if you put it right over ice).
Add 5-6 ice cubes and pour coffee to within about 1 inch of the top of the glass.
Rest a spoon on top of the coffee and slowly pour whipping cream into the spoon.
This will make the cream float on top of the coffee rather than dispersing into it right away.

cocktails.name: Thai Iced Coffee
steps: Prepare a pot of coffee at a good European strength.
In the ground coffee, add 2 or 3 freshly ground cardamom pods.
Sweeten while hot, then cool quickly.
Serve in highball glass over ice, with cream.
To get the layered effect, place a spoon atop the coffee and pour the milk carefully into the spoon so that it floats on the top of the coffee.

cocktails.name: Thai Iced Tea
steps: Combine Thai tea (i.e., the powder), boiling water, and sweetened condensed milk, stir until blended.
Pour into 2 tall glasses filled with ice cubes.
Garnish with mint leaves.
Makes 2 servings.

cocktails.name: The Evil Blue Thing
steps: Pour ingredients into glass, and drop in a blue whale!
The blue whale isn't really necessary, but it makes the drink more "fun".

cocktails.name: The Galah
steps: Mix together the alcoholic portions and top with Pineapple and Lime juice.

cocktails.name: The Jimmy Conway
steps: Fill glass with ice.
Pour in The Irishman and Disaronno.
Fill to the top with Cranberry Juice.
Garnish with a slice of lemon…Enjoy!

cocktails.name: The Last Word
steps: Shake with ice and strain into a cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: The Laverstoke
cocktails.garnish: snapped ginger slice and an awoken mint sprig
steps: Squeeze two lime wedges into a balloon glass then add the cordial, Bombay Sapphire and MARTINI Rosso Vermouth, swirl to mix.
Fully fill the glass with cubed ice and stir to chill.
Top with Fever-Tree Ginger Ale and gently stir again to combine.
Garnish with a snapped ginger slice and an awoken mint sprig.

cocktails.name: The Philosopher
steps: Add all the spirits in a shaker (best to use Hendricks gin) as well as the orange bitters and lemon juice.
Strain into a Margarita glass, top with Prosecco.

cocktails.name: The Strange Weaver
steps: Mix ingredients slowly in a glass with ice, garnish with orange slice.

cocktails.name: Thriller
steps: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients.
Shake well.
Strain into a cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Tia-Maria
steps: Boil water, sugar and coffe for 10 mins and let cool.
Add rum and vanilla.
Put in clean bottle(s) and leave for 1 week before using.

cocktails.name: Tipperary
steps: Stir over ice.
Strain into chilled glass.
Cut a wide swath of orange peel, and express the orange oils over the drink.
Discard orange twist.

cocktails.name: Tom Collins
steps: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, lemon juice, and sugar.
Shake well.
Strain into a collins glass alomst filled with ice cubes.
Add the club soda.
Stir and garnish with the cherry and the orange slice.

cocktails.name: Tomato Tang
steps: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended.
Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up.

cocktails.name: Tommy's Margarita
cocktails.lore: Invented by Julio Bermejo at Tommy's Mexican Restaurant in San Francisco in the 1990s, this stripped-down Margarita replaces the orange liqueur with agave syrup, letting the tequila take center stage. The IBA added it to their 'New Era Drinks' list in 2011, cementing its status as a modern classic.
cocktails.proTip: Use a quality 100% agave tequila — there's nowhere to hide in this recipe. The cleaner the tequila, the better the drink.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a cocktail shaker.
Fill with ice and shake vigorously for 12–15 seconds until well-chilled.
Strain into your prepared glass.
Garnish with lime wheel, optional salt rim.

cocktails.name: Turf Cocktail
steps: Stir all ingredients (except orange peel) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass.
Add the twist of orange peel and serve.

cocktails.name: Turkeyball
steps: Shake with ice and strain into a shot glass.

cocktails.name: Tuxedo Cocktail
cocktails.garnish: cherry and a twist of lemon zest
steps: Stir all ingredients with ice and strain into a cocktail glass.
Garnish with a cherry and a twist of lemon zest.

cocktails.name: Valencia Cocktail
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktails.name: Vampiro
steps: Vampiros may be made in a tall glass or an old fashioned glass.

Bartenders may first "rim" the glass with Kosher Salt, which is done by placing a layer of Kosher Salt on a chopping board, moistening the glass' rim with lime juice or water, and then placing the upside down glass rim onto the Kosher Salt, so that the salt sticks to the moistened rim.
The second step is to fill half the glass with ice and add one or two shooter glasses full of high quality Tequila.
The next stage is to add the flavouring elements.

This is done by squeezing a fresh lime into the glass, adding a few grains of salt, adding citrus-flavoured soda pop, until the glass is 4/5 full, and then adding spicy Viuda de Sanchez (or orange juice, lime juice and pico de gallo).
The final step is to stir the ingredients so that the flavours are properly blended.

cocktails.name: Van Vleet
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into an old-fashioned glass over ice cubes, and serve.

cocktails.name: Vermouth Cassis
steps: Stir vermouth and creme de cassis in a highball glass with ice cubes.
Fill with carbonated water, stir again, and serve.

cocktails.name: Vesper
steps: Shake over ice until well chilled, then strain into a deep goblet and garnish with a thin slice of lemon peel.

cocktails.name: Vesuvio
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into an old-fashioned glass over ice cubes, and serve.

cocktails.name: Veteran
steps: Pour the rum and cherry brandy into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes.
Stir well.

cocktails.name: Victor
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktails.name: Victory Collins
steps: Shake all ingredients (except orange slice) with ice and strain into a collins glass over ice cubes.
Add the slice of orange and serve.

cocktails.name: Vodka And Tonic
steps: Pour vodka into a highball glass over ice cubes.
Fill with tonic water, stir, and serve.

cocktails.name: Vodka Fizz
steps: Blend all ingredients, save nutmeg.
Pour into large white wine glass and sprinkle nutmeg on top.

cocktails.name: Vodka Lemon
steps: The vodka lemon is prepared directly in a highball glass or in a large tumbler: put 6-7 ice cubes in the glass, pour the vodka, lemonade and mix with a bar spoon.
Finally decorate with a slice of lemon and, if you prefer, add a few mint leaves.
Your vodka lemon is ready to be served.

cocktails.name: Vodka Martini
steps: Shake the vodka and vermouth together with a number of ice cubes, strain into a cocktail glass, add the olive and serve.

cocktails.name: Vodka Russian
steps: Mix it as a ordinary drink .

cocktails.name: Vodka Slime
steps: Fill glass with ice.
Add vodka, 7-up then finish with the lime juice.

cocktails.name: Vodka Tonic
steps: Wash and cut 1 wedge and 1 slice of lime or lemon.
Fill a tumbler with fresh ice.
Pour the desired dose of vodka and top up with the tonic.
Squeeze the lime wedge into the glass and decorate with the slice.
That's all, very simple: it's just the recipe for happiness!

cocktails.name: Waikiki Beachcomber
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktails.name: Whiskey Sour
cocktails.garnish: lemon wheel, Angostura bitters pattern on foam
cocktails.lore: The sour formula — spirit, citrus, sweetener — is one of the oldest templates in cocktail history, documented as far back as 1862 in Jerry Thomas's Bartender's Guide. The Whiskey Sour became a staple of American bars during Prohibition, when it helped mask the harsh flavor of poorly made bootleg whiskey.
cocktails.proTip: Always dry shake first (no ice) for a full 15 seconds if using egg white, then shake again with ice. This creates the thick, stable foam that defines a proper Whiskey Sour.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a cocktail shaker.
Dry shake (without ice) for 15 seconds first to emulsify the egg white.
Fill with ice and shake vigorously for 12–15 seconds until well-chilled.
Strain into your prepared glass.
Garnish with lemon wheel, Angostura bitters pattern on foam.

cocktails.name: Whisky Mac
steps: Pour both of the ingredients into a wine goblet with no ice.

cocktails.name: White Lady
steps: Add all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice.
Shake well and strain into large cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: White Russian
steps: Pour vodka and coffee liqueur over ice cubes in an old-fashioned glass.
Fill with light cream and serve.

cocktails.name: White Wine Sangria
steps: Chop the Lemon, Lime and other fruits into large chunks.
Fill the Pitcher with the white wine and mix in the Apple Brandy.
Top to taste with soda water.

cocktails.name: Whitecap Margarita
steps: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth.
This makes one drink.

cocktails.name: Wine Cooler
steps: Mix wine and soft drink.
Pour into glass.
Add ice.

cocktails.name: Wine Punch
steps: Combine all of the ingredients and pour over a block of ice.

cocktails.name: Winter Paloma
steps: Everyone’s favourite Paloma gets a delicious Indian makeover.
Tequila reposado infused with “Timur Pepper” which has citrusy & grapefruit notes and is grown at the foothills of Himalaya.
It also produces a slightly numbing and tingling sensation on your lip when consumed.
We have also spiced up the fresh grapefruit juice with the warming spice blend from Himalaya.
The combination of all these interesting elements has allowed us to elevate your Paloma sipping experience.

cocktails.name: Winter Rita
steps: Salt rim.
Combine all ingredients, shake with ice, and strain over fresh ice.⠀.

cocktails.name: Yellow Bird

cocktails.name: Yoghurt Cooler
steps: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended.
Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up.
Note: Use lots of ice in this one - great on hot days!
To add ice: Remove the center of the cover while the blender is on - drop 3 or 4 ice cubs and blend until they're completely crushed.

cocktails.name: Zambeer
steps: Mix sambuca with rootbeer and stir.
Add ice.

cocktails.name: Zenmeister
steps: Mix together and enjoy.

cocktails.name: Ziemes Martini Apfelsaft
steps: Serve without ice.
At least the juice shold have room temperature.

cocktails.name: Zima Blaster
steps: Fill glass with ice.
Pour in Chambord, then fill with Zima.
Mix and enjoy.

cocktails.name: Zimadori Zinger
steps: Pour Zima in a collins glass over ice and then pour the shot of Midori.
Don't stir.
Garnish with a cherry.

cocktails.name: Zinger
steps: Get a shot glass and pour in three shots of the schnapps.
Do the same with the Surge Cola.
Then down it like Scheetz would.

cocktails.name: Zipperhead
steps: Fill glass with rocks, add straw before putting in liquor.
Then add the ingredients in order, trying to keep layered as much as possible (i.e.
Chambord on bottom, then Vodka, Then soda on top).

cocktails.name: Zippy's Revenge
steps: Mix Kool-Aid to taste then add Rum and ammaretto. shake well to disolve the sugar in the Kool-Aid... serve cold.

cocktails.name: Zizi Coin-coin
steps: Pour 5cl of Cointreau on ice, add 2cl of fresh lemon (or lime) juice, stir gently, and finally add slices of lemon/lime in glass.

cocktails.name: Zoksel
steps: No specific mixing instructions, just poor every ingredient in one glass.
The lemon goes with it.

cocktails.name: Zombie
steps: Blend at high speed for no more than 5 seconds.
Pour into a glass, add ice cubes to fill, then add the garnish.
*Donn’s mix: Bring 3 crushed cinnamon sticks, 1 cup of sugar and 1 cup of water to a boil, stirring until the sugar is dissolved.
Simmer for 2 minutes, then remove from the heat and let sit for at least 2 hours before straining into a clean glass bottle.
Then add 1 part of the syrup and 2 parts of fresh grapefruit juice together.

cocktails.name: Zorbatini
steps: Prepare like a Martini.
Garnish with a green olive.

cocktails.name: Zorro
steps: add all and pour black coffee and add whipped cream on top.
